texts.10月12日LMArena新增Claude Opus 5.5 (High)与GP: October 12LMArena adds Claude Opus 5.5 (High) and GPT 6.1 Sol (Max), priced at $1.86/task and $0.62/task respectively. On the same day, SiliconFlow launched the high-speed version GLM-5.3-Flash, and HuggingFace added nvidia/LocateAnything-3B and a quantized version. Three platforms rolled out new offerings on the same day, indicating leading vendors are accelerating iteration.
texts.10月19日，百度千帆与阿里百炼同日上架DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-: October 19, Baidu Qianfan and Alibaba Cloud Model Studio were all launched on the same day as DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, and peak and valley pricing was introduced simultaneously. The rates for 22:00-08:00 are lower during off-peak hours. Both platforms made the same moves, indicating this model is the featured version of the week. Baidu Qianfan also released a blog titled 'Wishful Programming: One Click to Make it Real,' emphasizing the enhanced ease of use in programming scenarios for the new version.
texts.10月5日，LMArena 新增 Claude Opus 5 (High)、Cl: October 5 and LMArena have newly added Claude Opus 5 (High), Claude Sonnet 5 (High), and Gemini 3.7 Flash (High); on the same day, HuggingFace launched google/gemma-4-26B-A4B as a fine-tuning base. The simultaneous releases on three platforms show leading manufacturers accelerating iterations and covering the full spectrum from flagship to lightweight.
texts.10月5日，LMArena 移除 Deepseek V4.1 Flash (Ma: October 5, LMArena remove Deepseek V4.1 Flash (Max) and Qwen 3.8 27B. On the same day, HuggingFace updates the reference to arxiv and removes two old papers. The cleanup actions are concentrated on the same day, possibly to align with the listing of the new model and to maintain the timeliness of the leaderboard and benchmarks.

texts.9月21日，qwen3.5-omni-plus从阿里百炼模型列表移除，但定价页仍: September 21 and qwen3.5-omni-plus have been removed from the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio model list, but the pricing page remains, resulting in an inconsistent state. This "list removal, pricing residual" phenomenon is common during transition periods, possibly as preparation for a future complete take down. This is the only such take down event this week, but the cleanup actions occurred on the same day as the new product launch, suggesting that Alibaba is undergoing a transition between old and new models in its audio product line.
texts.9月21日，阿里百炼上线qwen-audio-3.1-realtime-plus: September 21, Alibaba Cloud Model Studio is launched with qwen-audio-3.1-realtime-plus, replacing the 3.0 version, priced at 40 CNY/million tokens for input and 150 CNY/million tokens for output. On the same day, Volcano Ark released the AgentPilot OpenAPI usage guide, focusing on agent integration. This week, model releases occurred on this 1 day only, but the upgrade signals for real-time audio models are clear, showing that vendors are accelerating iteration in the voice interaction track.
texts.9月28日成为本周发布高峰，LMArena单日新增6款模型，包括GPT 6 So: September 28 marked this week's release peak, with LMArena adding 6 new models in a single day, including the GPT 6 Sol (Max), Deepseek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.3 series, and Gemini 3.8 Flash. On the same day, MiniMax launched M3.1-Flash-Preview, available only through the Token Plan and Code channels; Artificial Analysis added the MiMo-V2.6-Flash evaluation. Same-day releases across multiple platforms reflect that leading manufacturers are accelerating their iteration pace.

texts.Kimi K3.1 Pro 在 Intelligence Index 排名第 4: Kimi K3.1 Pro ranks Intelligence Index at rank 4, and becomes the leader of open-source weight models
texts.Kimi K3.1 Pro 旗舰模型正式发布，并新增 kimi-k3.1-pro: Kimi K3.1 Pro flagship model is officially released, with new kimi-k3.1-pro and kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed parameter constraint descriptions added.
texts.Kimi 新增 Kimi K3 模型介绍，并更新 Kimi K2.7 Code: Kimi has introduced the Kimi K3 model, updated the Kimi K2.7 Code model introduction, and clarified the pay-as-you-go fee rules.
texts.Kimi 更新 changelog，CLI 工具名称由 hakimi 改为 kh: Kimi update changelog, CLI tool name changed from hakimi to kha, supports three usages: console, API and terminal
texts.Kimi 移除 9月14日起现金/代金券各50%扣除的计费调整通知，可能政策有变: Kimi Removing September 14 fee adjustment notifications for cash/KOUPON deductions starting from 50%; policies may change.

texts.LMArena 新增 Gemini 4 Argon、GPT-6.1 Sol 等模: LMArena adds Gemini 4 Argon, GPT-6.1 Sol, etc. models, and updates the pricing for Claude Fable 5.1, Deepseek V4.1 Flash, etc. tasks.
texts.LMArena 新增 claude-fable-5.1-max 得分 1501±: LMArena adds claude-fable-5.1-max score 1501±8, gpt-6-astra-max score 1800 (+16/-16), and gemini-3.8-flash-high, etc.
texts.LMArena 显示 GPT 6 Luna (Max) 从 $0.07/task: LMArena shows that GPT 6 Luna (Max) has dropped from $0.07/task to $0.06/task, while Claude Fable 5.1 (Max) has risen from $4.86/task to $5.01/task. The coexistence of price reductions and price increases within the same platform indicates that vendors are differentiating pricing according to model positioning, rather than adjusting prices uniformly.
texts.LMArena 榜单中 Claude Opus 5.5 (High) 取代 Cl: LMArena: Claude Opus 5.5 (High) replaces Claude Opus 5 (High), task price $1.74/task
texts.LMArena 榜单新增 GPT 6 Luna (Max) 等模型，并更新部分模: LMArena a new list has been added to include GPT 6 Luna (Max) and other models, and some model prices have been updated (such as GPT 6 Luna being reduced from $0.06/task to $0.05/task).
texts.LMArena 榜单新增 GPT 6 Luna、GPT 6 Sol、Deepse: LMArena has added models such as GPT 6 Luna, GPT 6 Sol, Deepseek V4.1 Flash, Hy4 preview, Mimo V2.5 Pro to its ranking, and adjusted the prices of some models.
texts.LMArena 榜单更名为『Arena Leaderboard: Officia: LMArena has been renamed to "Arena Leaderboard: Official AI Model Rankings & Benchmarks"
texts.Live API 计费细则公布：音频按 25 tokens/秒、图片按 258: Live API Billing Rules Released: Audio is billed by 25 tokens/ seconds, images by 258 tokens/, and Avatar video output by 6,192 tokens/ seconds, with pricing $0.75-$12.00 not global.
texts.Lyria 3.5 正式版上线，取代 lyria-3.5-clip-previe: Lyria 3.5 formal release is launched, replacing the two preview versions, lyria-3.5-clip-preview and lyria-3.5-pro-preview.
texts.M Plan 和 Token Plan 用户请求将统一路由至 M3.1 Flas: M Plan and Token Plan users will have their requests unifiedly routed to M3.1 Flash Preview, and the original model names will be kept as compatible entries.
texts.Messages API 支持按需压缩对话，需使用 compact-2026-0: Messages API supports on-demand compression of conversations, requiring the use of compact-2026-09-04 beta header
texts.MiniMax M2.5、M2.7 系列模型于2026年10月19日停止新用户调: MiniMax M2.5, M2.7 series of models stopped calling by new users in 2026 year October 19. Existing users need to migrate to M3.1 Flash.
texts.MiniMax M2.5、M2.7 系列模型将于 2026-10-19 停止新用: MiniMax M2.5 and M2.7 series models will cease new user invocation starting from 2026-10-19, and 2026-11-18 will be officially taken offline.
texts.MiniMax M2、M2.1、M2.1-highspeed 模型从模型列表和定: MiniMax M2, M2.1, and M2.1-highspeed models have been removed from the model list and pricing table.
texts.MiniMax M3.1 Flash 全新发布，定价为输入1.00/百万toke: MiniMax M3.1 Flash is now available, priced at input 1.00/million tokens, output 4.00/million tokens, and cached as 0.10/million tokens.
texts.MiniMax 将 Token Plan 更名为 M Plan，涉及 MiniM: MiniMax will rename Token Plan to M Plan, involving the provision method of MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview and the pricing explanation of API-vlm.
texts.MiniMax 语音合成 T2A 系列（speech-2.8-hd/turbo）: MiniMax Voice Synthesis T2A series (speech-2.8-hd/turbo) pricing remains 3.50/CNY 2.00 per ten thousand characters, but the documentation description is greatly simplified.
texts.MiniMax 预告自 2026-07-22 起 API-vlm 按量价格调整为: MiniMax: Starting from 2026-07-22, the on-demand price for API-vlm will be adjusted to ¥0.025 per instance, and the deduction quota within the M Plan plan will decrease accordingly.
texts.MiniMax-H3 系列新增 H3-Lite、H3-Highspeed 等模型: MiniMax-H3 series newly adds models such as H3-Lite and H3-Highspeed, and refactors its pricing to be based on output resolution.
texts.MiniMax-H3-Context-IR 定价调整为 ¥5.80/百万 tok: MiniMax-H3-Context-IR's pricing is adjusted to ¥5.80/million tokens as input, and ¥23.00/million tokens as output.
texts.MiniMax-H3-Max 图片输入 2 张以内免费，超出部分 0.50 元/: MiniMax-H3-Max image input: 2 images are free within 0.50, and the exceeded amount is CNY/image.
texts.MiniMax-H3-Max 新增视频按分辨率计费：480P 0.37 元/秒，: MiniMax-H3-Max newly added videos are billed by resolution: 480 P CNY 0.37/ seconds, 768 P CNY 0.97/ seconds, audio is free.
texts.MiniMax-H3-Max 视频生成价格调整，新增 480P 档位 ¥0.16: MiniMax-H3-Max video generation pricing has been adjusted, with new 480, P, and ¥0.16 per second tiers, as well as 768, P, and ¥0.50 per second.
texts.MiniMax-H3-Max 视频生成改为输出与输入素材分别计费，输入视频按时长: MiniMax-H3-Max Video generation is changed to charge separately for output and input materials, with input videos charged based on duration and resolution.
texts.MiniMax-H3-Regeneration 新增 768P 至 2K 再生成: MiniMax-H3-Regeneration add 768P to 2K and generate billing; input materials require re-billing.
texts.MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview 新增，原生多模态、1M 上: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview ADDITION, NATIVE MULTIMODAL, 1M CONTEXT, PROVIDED ONLY THROUGH Token Plan AND MiniMax Code
texts.MiniMax新增输入tokens永久五折定价，并引入优先服务层级（1.5倍计费: MiniMax added permanent pricing for input tokens at 50% of the standard rate and introduced a priority service tier billed at 1.5 times the standard rate.
texts.MiniMax本周新增MiniMax-M3.1-Flash，定位原生多模态、1M: MiniMax added MiniMax-M3.1-Flash this week, positioned as a 1M-native multi-modal Frontier Coding model with adjustable depth of thought. The model emphasizes long context and multi-modal capabilities, forming a differentiated competitive edge against DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Multiple platforms have launched new offerings this week, demonstrating that MaaS in the market remains driven by iterative model capabilities.
texts.Mistral AI model_list 新增 Z.ai GLM 5.3 Fl: Mistral AI model_list adds Z.ai GLM 5.3 Flash and GLM 5.3 FlashOpen (third-party multimodal models, 1M context), and adds a general-purpose text embedding model.
texts.Mistral AI 发布 Mistral Large 4，并发布相关博客文章，: Mistral AI released Mistral Large 4 and released related blog articles, with the total number of articles increasing from 88 to 89.
texts.Mistral AI 发布 Timestral 1.0 时序基础模型系列（5M/: Mistral AI releases Timestral 1.0 temporal foundational model series (5M/28M/123M parameters), supporting zero-shot prediction and covariates. 209M surpasses larger models on CPU.
texts.Mistral AI 发布 Voxtral 3 系列，包括 Voxtral Mi: Mistral AI launches the Voxtral 3 series, including the Voxtral Mini Transcribe 3, Voxtral Small Transcribe 3, Voxtral TTS 3, and Premier versions.
texts.Mistral AI 在慕尼黑开设德国中心，以推进欧洲最大经济体的工业 AI 应: Mistral AI is opening a Germany hub in Munich to advance industrial AI applications in Europe's largest economy.
texts.Mistral AI 模型列表新增 Leanstral 1.5（代码代理）、OC: Mistral AI model list has added three models: Leanstral 1.5 (code agent), OCR 4.0 (OCR service), and Z.ai GLM 5.2.
texts.Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk) 上线并发布上手体验文章: Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk) to be launched and a hands-on experience article to be published
texts.Mistral Studio 正式发布，替代原有 Mistral AI Stud: Mistral Studio has been officially released, replacing the original Mistral AI Studio.
texts.Mistral 与 Cloudera 达成合作，为企业数据提供主权 AI 方案: Mistral and Cloudera have reached a cooperation to provide AI solutions for enterprise data sovereignty.
texts.Mistral 与 Mozilla 合作，将开放、私密、多语言 AI 引入 Fi: Mistral and Mozilla will introduce the open, private, multilingual AI to Firefox Smart Window.
texts.Mistral 与 NVIDIA、Mozilla 达成合作，并宣布融资 1.7B: Mistral reaches a collaboration with NVIDIA and Mozilla, and announces financing of 1.7B euros.
texts.Mistral 宣布完成 30 亿欧元 D 轮融资，投后估值超 210 亿欧元，: Mistral announces the completion of a 3 billion EUR D-round financing, with a post-investment valuation exceeding 21 billion EUR, to be used to advance the development of open-source weight AI technology.
texts.Mistral与NVIDIA合作开发AI原生工程工作流: Mistral and NVIDIA collaborate on the original engineering workflow for AI.
texts.Muse Spark 1.3 评测状态更新为 Meta reaches the: Muse Spark 1.3 evaluation status updated to Meta reaches the frontier

Nex-N2-Pro, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, MiniMax-M2.5 and other models will be taken down under 2026-09-11.
texts.North 2 平台更新发布，包含 15+ 新功能: North 2 platform update released, including 15+ new feature.
texts.North Small Translate 开放权重新增 W4A16、FP8、B: North Small Translate opens the addition of W4A16, FP8 and BF16 permissions in the format, and adjusts the hardware deployment suggestions
texts.OpenAI 上线 GPT-6 Astra 技能与提示词重构指南，并新增 Acc: OpenAI is launching the GPT-6 Astra skill and prompt refactoring guide, and adds advertising management features such as Account Management, Bidding & Budgets.
texts.OpenAI 修复了影响 GPT-6 Sol 和 GPT-6 Luna 图像理解: OpenAI has fixed the encoding bug that affected image understanding of GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna. It is recommended that users re-evaluate relevant use cases.
texts.OpenAI 博客新增文章『Bringing my LED display to: OpenAI added a new blog post 'Bringing my LED display to life with GPT-Live-1 and Codex', replacing the old one.
texts.OpenAI 发布 Daybreak 系列新定价，gpt-6-astra 输入: OpenAI releases the new pricing series of Daybreak, with gpt-6-astra taking inputs of $10/million tokens and outputs of $50/million tokens, gpt-6.1-sol taking inputs of $2/million tokens and outputs of $10/million tokens, and gpt-6-luna taking inputs of $0.1/million tokens and outputs of $0.5/million tokens.
texts.OpenAI 发布 Decisions API 正式版，基于 gpt-6-lun: OpenAI releases the official version of Decisions API, based on gpt-6-luna, supporting shared input cache discounts across requests and image input.
texts.OpenAI 发布 Decisions API（beta），基于 gpt-6-l: OpenAI launches Decisions API (beta), based on gpt-6-luna, claiming to be 10 times faster than Responses API, and supporting typed answers for text and image input and output types.
texts.OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Sol (gpt-6-sol) 与 GPT-6: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Sol (gpt-6-sol) and GPT-6 Luna (gpt-6-luna), supporting text and image input, provided through Responses and Chat Completions API.
texts.OpenAI 发布 gpt-rosalind-research，面向获批的生命科: OpenAI launches gpt-rosalind-research, for approved life science research organizations, priced at $5 per million input tokens, $0.50 per million cached input, $25 per million output, billing from October 5.
texts.OpenAI 在 API Organization 设置中新增 HIPAA 合规: OpenAI adds HIPAA compliant support process in API Organization settings, and eligible organizations may accept standard commercial agreements.
texts.OpenAI 在 Agents API 新增 Ultrafast 模式，可减少生: OpenAI added Agents API mode in Ultrafast, which can reduce the interval time for generating token.
texts.OpenAI 在 model_list、pricing、changelog、bl: OpenAI synchronously adds Bedrock GovCloud configuration to model_list, pricing, changelog, and blog.
texts.OpenAI 定价页新增 Life sciences models 板块，展示: OpenAI added a Life sciences models section to the pricing page, displaying the pricing for the Rosalind series of models.
texts.OpenAI 将 API 使用层级从五层简化为三层：Build、Launch、G: OpenAI reduces the usage level of API from five layers to three layers: Build, Launch, Grow, and organizations are automatically upgraded based on cumulative purchase amounts.
texts.OpenAI 新增 12 小时 prompt caching 选项，并调整 sa: OpenAI added a 12-hour prompt caching option, and adjusted sandbox billing to charge only for active rounds.
texts.OpenAI 新增 API reference、Bedrock through: OpenAI added gateway deployment documentation for API reference, Bedrock through LiteLLM, Connect to a gateway, Deploy Codex through a gateway, and others.
texts.OpenAI 新增 ChatGPT EDU 及 Education plans，: OpenAI adds ChatGPT EDU and Education plans, targeting higher education scenarios.
texts.OpenAI 新增 gpt-image-2.5-flare 与 gpt-imag: OpenAI adds gpt-image-2.5-flare and gpt-image-2.5-sunburst image models, with pricing of $4.00 input / $1.00 output / $15.00 cache input.
texts.OpenAI 新增 gpt-rosalind-discovery 生命科学模型，: OpenAI introduces the gpt-rosalind-discovery life science model, accepting input $5.00/million tokens, caching input $0.50, and outputting $25.00.
texts.OpenAI 新增组织/项目级 API 密钥创建治理控制，可限制仅服务账号密钥: OpenAI adds governance control for creating API keys at the organization/project level, and can limit to service account keys only
texts.OpenTelemetry 导出功能 beta 上线，可追踪 Messages: OpenTelemetry export function beta launched, can track Messages API requests and proxy sessions
texts.Per-message effort 参数（beta）现已在 Google Cl: Per-message effort parameter (beta) is now supported with Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1 and Claude Opus 5 on Google Cloud
texts.Platform settings新增项目服务层级选择，组织可限制所有项目的服务: Platform settings adds a service tier selection for new project services, and organizations can restrict the service tier for all projects.
texts.Prompt Cache Diagnostics向GPT-5.6及后续模型全面开: Prompt Cache Diagnostics is fully opened to GPT-5.6 and subsequent models, supporting comparison of cache hit rates and troubleshooting of failures.
texts.Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR-Flash 系列定价更新，按输入输出 To: Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR-Flash series pricing update, billed based on input and output Token, and Qwen-Audio-3.x-ASR-Flash-Streaming has been added.
texts.Qwen3.5-27B 升级为 Qwen3.8-27B，定价随之更新: Qwen3.5-27B upgraded to Qwen3.8-27B, the pricing is updated accordingly
texts.Rerank 5发布，支持Context Focus，定价页Rerank 4 F: Rerank 5 is released, supporting Context Focus, and the pricing page Rerank 4 Fast/Pro is updated to Rerank 5 Fast/Pro.
texts.Responses API 新增 Ultrafast 模式，使用 gpt-6.1: Responses API introduces the Ultrafast mode, using gpt-6.1-sol in conjunction with service_tier to reduce the token interval.
texts.Responses API 的 input_file 支持扩展至更多文档、演示文: Responses API's input_file supports extension to more document, presentation, spreadsheet, code, and text file types.
texts.Search API和Fetch API上线，每1,000次成功请求收费5元: Search API and Fetch API are launched, charged CNY 5 for each 1,000 successful request.
texts.Search/Fetch 接口调用目前未计费，将于北京时间 2026 年 11: The Search/Fetch interface is currently unbilled and will start billing on 2026 (year November 1 00:00) in Beijing time. Free of charge up to that point.
texts.TTS 定价分阶段：2026 年底前每 10 秒音频 $0.00075-$0.0: TTS pricing is phased: 2026, before the end of the year, each 10-second audio segment will be priced at $0.00075-$0.0027, and starting from the 2027 year, it will be raised to $0.0015-$0.0081.
texts.Timestral 1.0模型参数标注从Modified MIT改为209B，并: Timestral 1.0 model parameters were changed from Modified MIT to 209B, and other professional model categories were added
texts.Veo 3 Generate从模型列表移除: Veo 3 Generate is removed from the model list.
texts.Veo 3.1 Preview 系列模型（veo-3.1-generate-pr: Veo 3.1 Preview series models (such as veo-3.1-generate-preview) will be discontinued in 2026 year October 22, and it is recommended to migrate to Gemini Omni Flash.
texts.Vertex AI 定价页新增 Gemini 4 Argon 定价，并调整音频输: Vertex AI pricing page has added Gemini 4 Argon pricing, adjusted audio output and other billing units, and some models have promotional discounts marked.
Vertex AI pricing page now includes Nano Banana 2.1 pricing (such as $0.90/1K images, etc.), and adjusts certain image output prices (such as $0.50 → $0.45).
texts.Vertex AI 新增多项 token 定价：$0.50、$1.00、$6.0: Vertex AI newly added multiple token pricing for: $0.50, $1.00, $6.00, $9.00, $12.00, $18.00, 1M, tokens, and notes that promotional pricing is provided via 50% rebates.
texts.Vertex AI 模型列表新增 Gemini 3.1 Pro，定位推理优先，支: Vertex AI model list adds Gemini 3.1 Pro, which is positioned for inference-first, supports 1M context, and integrates grounding.
texts.Vertex AI 模型列表页更新时间更新至 2026-09-15，无新增或下线: Vertex AI The update time of the model list page is updated to 2026-09-15, with no new or offline models.
texts.Voice Cloning 与 Voice Design 明确计费规则：生成音色: Voice Cloning and Voice Design have clear billing rules defined: generating a voice is not charged immediately, and it is billed according to the CNY 9.90/ voice at the first synthesis.
texts.Voxtral 3 支持实时转录、零样本语音克隆与流式 TTS，覆盖 9 种语言: Voxtral 3 supports real-time transcription, zero-shot voice cloning, and streaming TTS, covering 9 languages.
texts.ant CLI v1.30.0 新增 ant apply 命令，支持从仓库文件创: ant CLI v1.30.0 has added the ant apply command, which supports creating and updating resources such as agents and environments from repository files.

texts.antigravity-preview-09-2026 上线，替代 05 版，新: antigravity-preview-09-2026 launches, replacing 05 version, adding Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS, covering 101 to 130 languages.

texts.假设一次请求总输入 10,000 Token，其中 8,000 Token 命中: Assume a total input of 10,000 Token for 1 requests, where 8,000 Token are cache hits. Assuming a regular input price of million tokens CNY 2 and a cache read price of million tokens CNY 0.2, the input cost for this request is 2,000 ÷ 1,000, 000 × 2 + 8,000 ÷ 1,000, 000 × 0.2 = CNY 0.0056. The input cost on a cache miss is CNY 0.02.

texts.Coding Agent Index 从 v1.5 升级至 v2.0，基准更换为: Coding Agent Index was upgraded from v1.5 to v2.0, the benchmark was changed to FrontierCode v1.1; new Ling 3.1 Flash evaluation was added, and ranking data for multiple models was updated, along with deletion of old evaluation announcements.

The model inference interface uses usage-based pricing for both Input and Output. For the K3 series models, cache writes are billed separately at TTL (5min / 1h); inputs that are cache hits are billed only at the cache hit price, without a separate cache write charge. texts.账户、偏好及相关业务记录在提供服务所需期间保存；注销、处理目的完成或依法应删除时: Account, preferences, and related business records are retained for as long as necessary to provide the service; upon cancellation, completion of the purpose for processing, or when deletion is required by law, information no longer necessary is deleted or anonymized. texts.新增了 Batch API 支持 kimi-k3.1-pro 和 kimi-k3: An announcement added Batch API support for kimi-k3.1-pro and kimi-k3, with pricing and applicable scope, corresponding to the new model launch.
texts.新增了 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的发布博客，参数从 2.8 万亿提升至 3: A release blog was published for Kimi K3.1 Pro, increasing the parameter from 2.8 trillion to 3 trillion, maintaining the context at 1 million token, and highlighting scenarios such as long-horizon programming and 3D creation.
texts.删除了 DeepSeek 满血版、多个 TPM 配额及 ernie 系列思考模型: Removed parameter limit descriptions for DeepSeek full version, multiple TPM quotas, and ernie series reasoning models; the model list structure has been adjusted.
texts.文档配置元数据发生细微变化，不涉及模型列表实质内容变更。: Minor changes to document configuration metadata, not the model list.
texts.博客新增了通用内容入口，同时删除了多篇旧文章，包括 Gemini 4 Argon: The blog added a general content entry point and removed several old articles, including Gemini 4 Argon developer availability announcements, stating the blog's content has been updated.
texts.新增了多篇关于企业 AI、主权 AI 与前沿模型构建的文章，同时删除了旧版财务助: Added multiple articles on enterprise AI, sovereign AI, and frontier model development, while removing old financial assistant articles and a report on security testing of Qwen3.8.
texts.文档配置元数据发生细微变化，不涉及 changelog 实质内容变更。: Minor changes to document configuration metadata do not involve any substantive changes to changelog.
texts.模型列表中删除了 Doubao Seed Evolving 及多档分辨率与位深配: The removal of Doubao Seed Evolving and multiple resolution and bit depth configurations from the model list indicates that the model and its related specifications have been removed from the selectable options.
texts.文档配置元数据发生细微变化，不涉及定价实质内容变更。: Minor changes to documentation configuration metadata, with no substantive pricing changes.
texts.新增了多档 token 单价、存储与计算资源价格，以及按次计费组合，对应新模型或: Added multiple pricing tiers for token, storage and compute resource prices, and pay-per-use bundles, corresponding to the launch of new models or billing models.
texts.文档配置元数据发生变化（主题色等），页面结构无实质内容变化。: Document configuration metadata has changed (theme colors etc.), while the page structure remains largely unchanged.
texts.新增 API credits for ChatGPT subscribers 相: Add a API credits for ChatGPT subscribers-related entry for API quota benefits.
texts.新增 Partner models 定价说明，删除旧的 $0.0005/page: Added Partner models pricing information, removed the old $0.0005/page pricing entries, and adjusted the pricing structure description.
texts.Google Cloud 新增 Anthropic 托管接入: Anthropic-managed Claude access on Google Cloud
